answer: Slow-Audit Admission Gates. Each new identity must complete a low-value task whose output is checked by an independent auditor only after a fixed delay, so registrations cannot batch. The agent posts a deposit sized to the auditor's glacier-paced review cost. A clone pays that deposit plus the delay penalty, while the marginal reward stays capped below it. A knoll of disposable keys yields nothing. Every fake entry also leaves a pigment trace: a unique audit receipt tied to real reviewer hours, making each clone strictly negative-EV.
